text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...The decisive battle is finally upon us.
I am counting on you today—

During lunch break one day.
As I was walking down the hallway...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
P-President? W-What is she doing...?
I mean... just standing there, she gives off such an insane aura.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, she took something out—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "Yahoo~! How is everyone doing~?"

text_block_list.name: Luna-chan
text_block_list.text:
"Aha, did I startle you? Sorry about that!
I'm... I mean, Luna-chan!
Rudolf's friend!"

text_block_list.name: Watching Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
—Umm... wh-what's going on?
—Is she... campaigning with ventriloquism or something...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm~~... P-President...-san??
Is something troubling you~...?

text_block_list.name: Luna-chan
text_block_list.text:
"Geez, no way! I'm Luna-chan!
There are tons of differences between me and Rudolf, right?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? ...Ah!!
You're tiny, like a half-order of fried rice!

text_block_list.name: Luna-chan
text_block_list.text:
"Exactly! Rudolf is a full-sized fried rice!
Wait... isn't that a super bizarre comparison!?"

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
...Pfft, ahaha!
Calling the president fried rice...!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl D
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, wanna go closer...?
The vibe seems pretty friendly...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm! Luna-chan-san! That is...
Do you happen to know the President's favorite books!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
She is one of the academy's... great heroines, so... um...
I was wondering what kind of books she reads on a daily basis.

text_block_list.name: Luna-chan
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, let me see... Ah!
That one, that one! 'The Complete Encyclopedia of East-West Puns'~♪"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...H-Her mouth really isn't moving at all.
That's amazing... I wonder how she practiced.

text_block_list.name: Luna-chan
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, it's Cheval Grand-chan! Yay♪
I've been wanting to talk with you too~!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: T-Talk!? W-With someone like me...!?
...Even after that, students continued to flock around Symboli Rudolf and Luna-chan non-stop, turning her into the star of the school in an instant.
After school that day, I spotted Symboli Rudolf walking alone in the school building.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it is you... So, how was it?
How was "Luna-chan" earlier today?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Remember our chat after school the other day?
Regarding my new initiative.
choice_data_list: It was amazing! A total success!
It was amazing! A total success!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, is that so!
I felt a sense of achievement myself, but...
it seems it was not mere conceit on my part.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Remember our chat after school the other day?
Regarding my new initiative.
choice_data_list: So that cute thing was what you meant!
So that cute thing was what you meant!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, did your prediction prove correct?
For me, it took quite a leap of courage, however.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Even so, to think that merely mediating through "Luna-chan" would close the distance between everyone and myself to such an extent...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If I keep this up, eventually I myself will be able to converse with everyone as equals—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Ah, P-President! ...Umm...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
About... during lunch break, that was amazing!
...We'd... love to chat again...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, understood.
I shall certainly bring "Luna-chan" along again.
Please get along well with her when that time comes.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Yes...! G-Goodbye!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told... constant dripping wears away stone...
I had assumed it would be a long, arduous journey. Yet—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Is this what it feels like to leap for joy?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Next time, I shall also consider wearing a full mascot suit.
